scope: Critical lifecycle design review; docs, primary-source research, targeted static code reads. No product changes, runtime verification or E02 code acceptance.
architecture_boundary: Existing CTM/S0/identity/PV govern. Actual system-design-decisions unchanged; exact C03 proposal outside authoritative directory is optional and pending human agreement.
denominator_scope: Complete arrays in families.json, grounds.json, sources.json; complete R01–R12/T01–T20/W0–W6 in lifecycle/06; 15 comparison rows in lifecycle/07 (not unique publications or proofs). Counts are recomputed by root.
delegation: One level, direct agents. Root sole tracked writer; agents wrote assigned ignored notes. No children, product execution, new environments, data downloads, cleanup or production payload access.
root_review: Read seven research reports, two independent initial and delta reviews, and final documents. Re-read decisive pinned claim_support, decision_validity, claim models and memory influence seams plus ratified SDD sections. Verified selected primary-source sections. This is neither a complete code callgraph nor a systematic literature census.
decisions: Native owner protocols, no sovereign GroundService, universal temporal envelope or mandatory Capability DTO.
Source-specific snapshot/CDC cuts, sparse continuity, incarnation and durable data-before-progress.
Assertion/assessment/use are logical roles in existing contracts; ref presence and count shape cannot prove semantic support or independence.
Claim-relative memory selection trace; bounded candidate exploration is allowed without a complete rejected corpus.
Object and set/negative dependencies; source-owner journal/generation commit, C-to-W enrollment and retained replay, explicit retention-floor failure.
Named participating publication fence and read cut; optimistic snapshot is not a later protected-action fence. Local-known currentness does not freeze external reality.
Public consumer composes existing PV dimensions and negative/disclosure obligations; historical authenticity is distinct from current authority.
Applicable rights decision precedes scoped restriction; copy intents, late-write fences, restore quarantine and independently retained post-backup decisions.
Duty/intent/attempt/effect separation; effect identity per step; finite provider dedupe window and unknown-outcome reconciliation.
Operation-specific compatibility, predicate-relevant caches, physical budgets, controlled-root GC fence and real second-source acceptance.

independent_review_result.protocol: No blocking contradiction after journal/read-cut and GC-final-delete refinements; documentary disposition only.
independent_review_result.authority: Three original gaps addressed; no blocking contradiction. Nonblocking T06/T07 unrelated-generation overgate ambiguity corrected by root after final review.

checks.scope: Documentation-only stdlib + read-only Git. No product execution. Receipt self-hash excluded.

remaining_limits: No proposed cross-owner protocol or future probe executed. All 20 protocol probes UNRUN.
Before implementation recheck current source delta, complete participating caller/writer/reader denominator and concrete backend transaction/restore boundaries.
External source continuity, actual rights/issuer/hold/law, empirical warrants and provider behavior cannot be minted by this design.
Cross-store currentness without a proven read/commit protocol remains qualified; physical GC without complete controlled roots/writers remains disabled in that scope.
Optional C03 approval pending; no existing SDD semantics changed. Implementation under already ratified rules need not wait for the clarification.
Primary research is selected-section review; live URLs are not immutable execution inputs. Local research notes are ignored receipts, not published source copies.

resource_scope.allowed_operations: Small file edits, bounded git show/cat-file/diff, web text research, stdlib documentary validation. Normal docs publication hooks expected to select no product files.
